description:
Today, comedian and actor Russell Brand has been found guilty of rape and three sexual offences and remanded in custody ahead of his sentencing next week.

Adam is joined by Anoushka Mutanda-Dougherty, presenter of Fame Under Fire, who has attended every day of 51-year-old Brand’s trial. They discuss the counts the jury found Brand guilty on, how the trial unfolded and further rape allegations made by two women which can now be reported.

Also, following a successful result for the Democrats in the US midterm elections, how could Trump’s electoral defeat play out in the rest of the world? Adam is joined by our International Editor, Jeremy Bowen, to assess what it might mean for US involvement in the Middle East, the war between Russia and Ukraine, and Trump’s plans for Cuba.

author: BBC News
description:
A wave of intense and, at times, unpredictable storms exacerbated by the El Niño weather pattern has killed dozens, shuttered major airports and wiped out crops and infrastructure across a swathe of East Asia.
 
El Niño is a naturally occurring climate phenomenon in which warm waters pooling in the eastern Pacific and altered wind patterns drive extreme weather events around the world. It happens around every two to seven years, lasting for around a year. 
 
This year's El Niño, which the UK Met Office has forecast to be the "strongest in living memory", is likely to last until February or March.
 
Wild weather is a way of life for people living along the coast in the Philippines, Taiwan, China and Japan but the BBC examines how the last few months have been extraordinary.

author: BBC News
description:
Married at First Sight UK has been axed after a BBC investigation into the reality TV series, Channel 4 has confirmed.
 
The show faced major controversy earlier this year after a BBC Panorama investigation uncovered rape allegations from two female contestants, alongside a third woman’s allegation of a non-consensual sexual act. The men accused have denied all allegations.
 
Channel 4 commissioned an independent review after the BBC first approached the broadcaster with details of the claims. The review, completed on Thursday, recommended additional safeguards for the programme.
 
However, Channel 4 has now confirmed that the show has “run its course”, while issuing an apology to the women involved in the investigation.

author: BBC News
description:
The Court of Appeal judges have ruled Vickrum Digwa's original 21-year jail sentence for the murder of Henry Nowak was unduly lenient.
 
Digwa stabbed the 18-year-old student to death in Southampton in December 2025. He had sought permission to challenge the length of his sentence at the Court of Appeal.
 
Jonathan Polnay KC, for the Attorney General, earlier argued Digwa's 21-year minimum term was too lenient, citing his use of a large dagger, abusing the religious exemption to carry it, and his conduct as Henry Nowak lay dying.
 
The appeal court judges ruled the initial sentence "did not adequately reflect the overall seriousness of the murder" and he was handed a 25-year sentence.

author: BBC News
description:
Hundreds of thousands of demonstrators are taking part in marches across France as five unions join strikes and protests in a national day of action.
 
The protests began in September with high school students complaining about poor conditions and resources in education, but have spread to include the so-called "yellow-vest" movement and workers.
 
Authorities expect 500,000 to 700,000 demonstrators to join marches, with tens of thousands more in Paris alone, in a day billed by one union leader as "a great day of convergence".
 
The five unions have combined forces across the public and private sector, with demands for higher wages to combat the cost of living and protected public services.
 
Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez has said that 70,000 police and gendarmes are being deployed, vowing "an extremely firm response" to any potential outbreaks of violence.

description:
Portugal legend Cristiano Ronaldo says he is retiring from international football.

The 41-year-old forward has scored 146 goals and won 234 caps for his country - both world records - since making his debut in 2003.

"To the Portuguese people, the day has come for me to hand back the number seven shirt of our national team," Ronaldo said in an Instagram video.

"I never felt it belonged to me alone, but for 23 years I had the privilege and responsibility of wearing it, defending it and carrying it with me into stadiums all around the world."

author: BBC News
description:
Joshua Wong, once the face of Hong Kong's democracy movement, has been sentenced to 10 years in jail for colluding with foreign forces under the city's sweeping national security law.
 
Wong is among hundreds of campaigners and ordinary Hongkongers arrested under the law, which was imposed in 2020 following explosive pro-democracy protests against Beijing's growing control.
 
Critics say the far-reaching law has silenced dissent, but authorities argue that it is needed to maintain stability and deny it has weakened the city's cherished autonomy.
 
Having already spent the last six years in jail, Wong, who was due to be freed in January, will now spend another decade behind bars.
